description: Seed values taken from retained QRNG draws. allocations: code literals (path, seed name, value, draw record, index). runtime: values a CLI seed flag took as qrng:<draw>#<index> (draw record, index, value, script, flag, experiment), added by ci/seed_provenance.py --add-runtime in the change that retains the run. ci/seed_provenance.py checks every row against its draw and allows each (record, index) once.
